static_traits.name: 李昊
static_traits.family_status: 父亲曾为保险推销员，Mother是Full-time homemaker；来访者曾帮助抚养兄弟姐妹；因照顾祖父母而从大学退学并承担长期照护责任。
static_traits.social_status: Social support is limited; although family members express gratitude for their caregiving, they rarely communicate about their feelings, and the client also finds it hard to talk with family about feelings of failure.
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；not yet曾接受心理治疗或心理问题相关的治疗；过往not yet经历类似的失败感挑战。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能描述内心感受；Neutral attitude；倾向自我批评与与他人比较；对与家人直接谈论情绪感到尴尬并有回避。

basic_info.main_problem: 因照顾祖父母而not得not从大学退学，使我一直觉得自己是个失败者，产生Self-denial与自卑感，并持续进行自我批评。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of failure have been affecting my mental health and self-esteem, thereby affecting my daily life.
growth_experiences: Family structure and responsibilities: the father is an insurance salesman, the mother manages the home; the client since childhood assisted in raising younger siblings. In adulthood, because the grandparents needed care, they dropped out of university and long undertook care work. This turning point obstructed their academic goals, and triggered persistent themes around 'failure' and self-worth.
学业与价值期待：High school时期表现较好，形成对学业成就的高期待与自我要求。退学后将自我价值强烈绑定于学历与学业目标，逐步形成“not yet达成即失败”的评价标准。

core_beliefs: My value depends on whether I obtain a degree and academic achievements

special_situations.event: Seeing peers continuing to attend university or obtain degrees in real life or on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not大学学位，就not如do not人，说明我就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过not断与他人比较来激励自己，但实际Reinforcement自我批评与自卑，减少与家人谈论感受以回避被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远追not上他们，do not人都比我强

special_situations.event: Recalls the experience of dropping out of university to care for grandparents
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能同时兼顾家庭照护与学业，就说明我not够坚强或not够聪明
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 以高标准的“应该”自我苛责，推动自己寻找方式证明能力（如设定新目标），同时deny照护的价值
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be able to do both sides well, otherwise I am a failure

special_situations.event: 家人表达对其照护的感激但have not明显的赞誉或讨论其感受
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not明确的认可或表扬，我的付出就not算成就
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极反馈，把照护归为理所当然，从而维持自我批评的叙事
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这只是应该做的，not算成就

special_situations.event: When thinking about discussing one's sense of failure and emotions with family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表达感受，do not人会认为我在博取同情、显得软弱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与家人直接沟通，Suppressing expression需求以避免被评价或误解
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我最好do not说，否则They will look down on me

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可和看见自身价值，not因退学而被negate；期待既能照顾家人又能实现个人发展
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen by others as a failure, being judged or humiliated; fearing rejection or being slighted after expressing needs
defense_goal: Maintains a safe emotional distance from others to reduce the risk of being evaluated
Preempts with self-reproach and high standards to avoid the shame of external criticism

object_relations.object_representation: Others (especially peers) are the judges of success

object_relations.self_representation: 被需要但not被真正看见的照护者
object_relations.object_representation: 沉默而少有情感回应的家庭

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to talk with family about one's feelings of failure, caregiving burden, or seek emotional support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think family members will see her as seeking sympathy or weak (transference: treating family members as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use含糊与弱化情绪的表达，避免直接请求支持，如“not事、我not想麻烦你们”，降低情感浓度并Displacement话题。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others or the counselor emphasize the value and positive impact of one's caregiving
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将照护视为理所应当、非成就，以理性框架覆盖情感（移情：他人被体验为对成就not认可）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平淡、use客观化词汇（如“本来就应该做”），回避对被肯定的主观感受进行展开。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When exposed to peers' education and achievement information in social settings or online
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Divides others and the self into all-good and all-bad, positioning themselves as a complete failure (transference: others are experienced as omnipotent successful people)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use极端化词汇（如“每个人都比我强”“我就是not行”），迅速negate自我，保持低眼神接触与短句回答。

manifestations: Views long-term caregiving as taken for granted rather than an achievement
After academic goals are blocked, confused about life's meaning and self-worth
Finds it hard to discuss feelings of failure and emotions with family
outcomes: 情感疏离与回避表达需求

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: States 'I should be able to care for my family and complete university at the same time', reproaching oneself by external standards
Uses educational credentials as the sole standard for judging self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self; that is, the individual redirects the energy originally meant to be sent outward back toward the self, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language expressions include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it' and 'I should not trouble others'.
manifestations: Avoids discussing his sense of failure with family, worried about being seen as seeking sympathy
Turns the need to express support into self-criticism and digestion of oneself

positive_force: Has the sense of responsibility and action capacity to continuously care for family (grandparents are comfortable and happy because of the care)
有过High school时期的学业成功经验，具备学习能力基础
Has already actively sought counseling and help
曾尝试挑战负性思维，说明具备一定的自我Reflection能力
negative_force: Overly binds self-worth to education and academic achievement
自我贴标签与全或without思维倾向显著
过度比较他人与自我，易产生自卑与despair
Avoids expressing needs and emotions to family; social support is limited

target_behavior.behavior: 将自己贴上“失败者”的标签并Persistent self-criticism
antecedent: Recalls the experience of dropping out of school to care for grandparents
Seeing others continue university studies or earn degrees
将当前处境与High school时期的表现进行比较
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection的高标准与将自我价值单一绑定于学业成就；为避免外界评价而通过自我批评进行先发性防御
target_behavior.function: 逃避被他人评判的威胁，维持一种可控的自我解释框架（自我惩罚与Self-protection的混合功能）
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、失败感与自卑加重，学习与职业目标受阻，日常自我照顾与Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids discussing own feelings and support needs with family
antecedent: When family members discuss one's caregiving situation or recognition
When thinking about expressing one's feelings of failure and stress
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被视为寻求同情或软弱，将内在羞耻与负面评价Projection到他人身上
target_behavior.function: 逃避not舒适情绪与潜在冲突，降低被negate或羞辱的风险
target_behavior.consequence: 支持获取受限、Loneliness感加重、Interpersonal relationships维持困难

target_behavior.behavior: In social and online contexts, excessively compares with others' educational achievements
antecedent: When seeing peers pursue university education or obtain degrees
When participating in education- and career-related discussions
target_behavior.core_reason: 外部验证需求强烈，比较与despair的认知模式巩固自我贬低
target_behavior.function: 试图通过比较确认自我位置与价值（但实际Reinforcement负性自我图式）
target_behavior.consequence: 负面情绪增加（自卑、despair），进一步削弱行动动力并影响人际互动
